name: Dev workflow
description: Skills and agent setups that plan, review, test and ship code for you: the loop from idea to merged pull request, run by your coding agent.

name: Research
description: Tools that send your agent out to search, read and synthesise: web and social research, deep dives, trend tracking and grounded summaries.

name: Marketing
description: Agent tooling for growth work: paid ads, SEO, content marketing, campaigns and the audits and reports that go with them.

name: Design & diagrams
description: Skills that make your agent better at visual work: interfaces, diagrams, slides and anything you need to look at rather than read.

name: Writing
description: Tools for text: editing, rewriting, tone and style, and keeping agent-written prose from sounding like every other agent.

name: Security
description: Scanners and guardrails for the agent era: vetting skills and MCP servers before you install them, and catching prompt injection, exfiltration and supply-chain risks.

name: Agent teams
description: Rosters of specialist subagents and personas you install as a set, so one harness can act as a whole team of experts.

name: Models & infrastructure
description: The plumbing under your agents: gateways, routers and proxies that decide which model answers, keep requests flowing when a provider fails, and track what it all costs.

name: Media generation
description: Tools for making images, video, audio and 3D with generative models, from node-graph pipelines to generators your agent can call.

name: Careers & job search
description: Agent workflows for finding work: sorting job postings, tailoring CVs and cover letters, and preparing for interviews.

name: Desktop & productivity
description: Everyday desktop tools with AI built in: launchers, clipboard and snippet managers, and the small utilities that sit between you and your work.

name: Data extraction
description: Tools that pull structured data out of the web and out of documents: scrapers and crawlers, OCR and document parsers, and monitors that watch pages for changes.

name: Sales & CRM
description: Agent tooling for selling: CRMs that keep themselves up to date, contact and company research, and pipeline work handed to agents.
